accepts.description: Zero-signup web scraping, HTML-to-JSON extraction & compliance checks ($0.01 USDC on Base or 1 prepaid credit).

description: Fast key-value entity extraction from raw web or document text when you only need a flat list of named fields rather than a full nested JSON Schema. Ideal for pulling contacts, dates, tickers, or metadata out of messy text (max 6,000 bytes).

content.description: Raw web or document text to scan (max 6,000 bytes).

fields.description: Exact entity or field names to extract as keys.

name: parse_web_schema
